notes: Committed default stays Esmeralda so https://mzee04.github.io/cursed-pumpkin/ keeps reading the testnet game. Select mainnet in the page, or open ?network=mainnet. Leave mainnet template, component, pumpkin, and publishTx empty until a human publishes and copies the real addresses. Do not copy Esmeralda addresses into the mainnet fields.

esmeralda.label: Esmeralda testnet
esmeralda.indexerNotes: First URL is the one the live site and the recorded game already use. The esme-indexer hosts are the Esmeralda public indexers in the exchange-integration guide (checked 2026-11-11). The app tries them in order.
esmeralda.explorerNotes: Esmeralda's stable explorer. explorer.tari.mw still served this testnet on 2026-11-11 and becomes the mainnet explorer at launch. Recorded step links inside web/data/recorded-game.json are the historical explorer.tari.mw URLs; the replay rewrites them onto this explorer.

mainnet.label: Ootle mainnet
mainnet.indexerNotes: From the exchange-integration guide on 2026-11-11. That guide still says some mainnet values are placeholders that can change before launch. Both hosts returned HTTP 523 at 2026-11-11T00:32Z. Re-check the guide and GET /network before publishing. Point the wallet at whichever host answers with network mainnet.
mainnet.explorerNotes: Veil moves explorer.tari.mw to mainnet when the mainnet indexer is serving. Esmeralda stays at testnet-explorer.tari.mw.
